Alpha 3: a new Home, a new logo, and a faster, quieter app.

- New minimal Home: the time, one Resume button and shortcuts, with a console-style start-up animation.
- New logo.
- Every backend command now runs off the main thread, which should fix the lag and unresponsive touch.
- Search, Transfers and Settings icons respond to clicks and taps again.
- Legion Go controller battery and attach toasts are back.
- Navigation sounds play under WebView2.
- Tailscale integration removed.
- A Linux test build (tarball) is attached.
